principle_violations.reason: In this implementation, every shape you create would have to implement the volume method. However, you cannot calculate a volume from every shape. This interface forces the Square class to implement a method that it does not need. This violates the Interface Segregation Principle
principle_violations.suggestion: In order to comply with the Interface Segregation Principle separate interfaces for 2D and 3D shapes. The 2D interface implements the area method, the 3D interface the volume method.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
